Appreciate the clarifying questions — quick technical notes so we can align the MAP items: 

- Retention windows: Redwood supports configurable retention on a per-tenant basis. Defaults are 13 months for audit logs; data retention for content can be set to any TTL between 0 days and 7 years depending on contract. We can add presets, e.g., 365d for PHI, 30d for session data.
- Audit log schema: attached a small sample (log-schema-example.json). The schema includes the fields Ben listed plus request_path, response_hash, and actor_ip. We expose an export API so logs can be streamed to your SIEM or pulled as periodic exports.
- BYOK / KMS: We support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM integration). For BYOK with HSM-backed keys, there is a short onboarding step (key registration + test wrap/unwrap).
- Proof-of-deletion: We provide deletion attestations: delete operation produces an audit entry with deletion_token and a digest; we can produce a signed attestation document for procurement/legal.

Proposed owners (to fold into the MAP):
- Marissa: MAP timeline & Olive commercial lead.
- Monica: Security/compliance technical sign-off and sample evidence delivery.
- Karthik: SOW and procurement liaison.
- Ben/Aisha: Olive technical owner and legal/procurement owner (Ben for legal/comms).

I'll drop the sample schema in Drive and link it in the MAP. I also attached the schema to this email for quick review.

I think the proposed dates are achievable if we lock owners this week and get procurement into the loop.

Thanks everyone — quick compliance notes and constraints to add into the MAP before we lock dates: 

1) PHI handling:
- Redwood can support HIPAA workflows but we require an executed BAA before any PHI is ingested. Please route Legal to our contracts team (I can introduce).
- For PHI-specific customers we recommend private deployment or VPC network isolation plus customer-managed keys.

2) Audit logging & retention:
- Required audit-log fields for Olive (confirm with your auditors) should include: user_id, request_id, timestamp, action_type, model_version, resource_id, actor_ip, and response_hash.
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention up to 7 years. For audit evidence we can retain logs for 7 years if Olive requires it, but defaults remain 13 months to balance cost.
- For regulatory or payer customers we often see 6–7 year retention requirements; please flag any specific regulatory authority if different.

3) Proof-of-deletion & attestation:
- We will provide deletion attestations and a signed digest proving deletion of content and KV cache. For higher-assurance workflows we can run a quarterly attestation or provide ad-hoc signed statements for specific deletion events.

4) Encryption & keys:
- BYOK is supported. For PHI we recommend HSM-backed keys (customer-managed) and we will document key lifecycle processes in the MAP.

5) Telemetry & telemetry controls:
- We can disable downstream telemetry and analytics collection for regulated workloads; note this will reduce aggregated usage analytics in the console.

Next steps from compliance side:
- I will upload a short "required evidence" checklist into the MAP by 2027-05-04 (items: SOC 2 report, BAA template, sample log export, key onboarding checklist).
- Please confirm owners so we can stick to the proposed timeline. I agree with Marissa that target close 2027-05-31 is realistic if owners and procurement steps are started this week.

Proposed sign-off call: 2027-05-06 10:00 PT — 30 minutes (finalize owners and legal checklists).

Thanks,
